row.evidence: LinkSquares support FAQ: "How do I find more information about SCIM" - "Reach out to your CSM, AM or Technical Support"; no SCIM documentation or plan is published.
row.notes: Quote-only: LinkSquares publishes no plans or prices ("personalized pricing based on the number of users, contract volume, and features required"). SCIM is not documented: the only mention in the help centre is a support FAQ that says to contact your CSM, AM or Technical Support for SCIM information, so availability and plan are unknown (rule 6a needs the vendor to describe SCIM). SAML 2.0 SSO is documented (legacy SSO feature) with custom/non-gallery apps in Okta and Entra; users must already exist and be enabled in LinkSquares. Admins disable users manually (frees the license) before deleting. The public API (API-key auth) exposes a read-only Finalize user lookup (GET /api/finalize/v2/users, filter by email); no user create/disable endpoints. Audit logs are downloadable as XLSX, no audit-log API found.
